Ahmed Basil.note: Fadhil sits behind the starter for Iraq, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Ahmed Basil.noteZh: 他给Iraq保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Ahmed Maknzi.noteZh: 他是Iraq在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Ahmed Qasem.note: Qasem gives Iraq midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.

Ali Al-Hamadi.noteZh: 他给Iraq替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Ali Jasim.note: Jasim is one of Iraq's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Ali Jasim.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Iraq来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Ali Yousif.note: Yousif gives Iraq a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Ali Yousif.noteZh: 他是Iraq在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Amir Al-Ammari.summary: Amir Al-Ammari is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Cracovia who gives the national team screening, left-footed passing, and set-piece support.
Amir Al-Ammari.note: Al-Ammari has already made a goal happen for Iraq. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Amir Al-Ammari.noteZh: 他已经为Iraq送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Aymen Hussein.note: Hussein's World Cup has already included a goal against Norway. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Aymen Hussein.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。
